requirements.quote: Meter design may be incorporated in a single PCB (Main board, Power supply and Display) and NIC Card separately.
requirements.text: Meter design should use a single PCB for main board, power supply, and display, with a separate NIC card.

requirements.quote: Module should support IPV4 and IPV6 communication, according to the availability of the network it should work in 4G fall back to 2G/NB-IoT/RF/other Future Networks.
requirements.text: Communication module must support IPV4 and IPV6 and work with 4G fallback to 2G/NB-IoT/RF.

requirements.quote: Communication Module Type: Pluggable and universally compatible one, and easily switchable between communication technology with in a single module (Ex: GPRS / NB-IoT/RF Mesh).
requirements.text: Communication module must be pluggable, universally compatible, and switchable between technologies like GPRS, NB-IoT, and RF Mesh.

requirements.quote: the communication module should be able to set to NB-IoT / RF in the areas wherever the other technology is not suitable.
requirements.text: Communication module must support switching to NB-IoT or RF where other technologies are unsuitable.

requirements.quote: The antenna used in the communication module should be with minimum 5-db gain.
requirements.text: Communication module antenna must have a minimum 5-db gain.

requirements.quote: Polycarbonate meter casing suitable for IS 16444 type test, ultrasonic welding with ingress protection to IP 51/55 standards.
requirements.text: Meter casing must be polycarbonate, IS 16444 compliant, ultrasonically welded, and meet IP 51/55 standards.

requirements.quote: Polycarbonate meter box, type tested as per IS standards (Input / Output gland size suitable for 20mm round / flat cable), box top cover may be book open type / as per customer requirements.
requirements.text: Meter box must be polycarbonate, IS standard tested, with 20mm gland size and customizable top cover.

requirements.quote: Smart Energy Meter should be type tested as per IS 16444 standards with latest amendments in an NABL approved and accredited laboratory.
requirements.text: Smart Energy Meter must be IS 16444 type tested in an NABL accredited lab.

requirements.quote: Meter manufacturer / supplier should have in-house NABL or ISO/ IEC - 17025 accredited Laboratory as on the date of application.
requirements.text: Manufacturer/supplier must have an in-house NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab.

requirements.quote: Single Phase 2 Wire, whole current Smart Energy Meter including pluggable GPRS communication module as per IS :16444 Part-1, Accuracy Class 1.0, Current Rating 5-30 A / 5-60A / 10-60 A and 10-100A with Backlit LCD Display, Net metering facility, default postpaid facility with prepaid facility built-in.
requirements.text: Single-phase smart meter must meet IS 16444 Part-1, Accuracy Class 1.0, and specified current ratings.
